name: Price monitoring with Telegram and email alerts

parameters.content:
## What you told me, in plain English

1. You follow the same products across several online stores
2. You want to find a product and mark it for tracking
3. Something checks those prices for you, on a schedule
4. A price drop reaches your phone and your inbox
5. A simple page to add and manage products, no design work
6. Stable and boring, almost no involvement from you

## To go live, we wire

- The stores you buy from, your Telegram chat and the inbox that gets the alert
- Telegram is instant and free; WhatsApp can only message you first with an approved template
- A store that hides its price in JavaScript needs its own small rule, that is the usual half day
